en: A vintage, ornately framed printed view of a large 19th‑century industrial textile complex with long factory buildings, smoking chimneys, a gated entrance, and surrounding trees. Decorative flourishes in the margins contain French text identifying the company and location. The overall layout and blank lower area suggest it was used as a trade postcard or price list cover rather than a tourist card.
